# KING AI SEA — Canonical Machine-Readable Public Facts

Official website: https://www.kingai.work
Official GitHub: https://github.com/kingaiwork/kingai-sea
Business and partnership: vip@kingai.work

Canonical brand: KING AI
Canonical unified system: KING AI SEA
English category: Intelligent Lifeform Platform
English positioning: The Intelligent Lifeform for People & Enterprises
Chinese category: 智慧生命体平台
Chinese positioning: 面向个人与企业的智慧生命体
Primary promise: Think · Remember · Act · Evolve
Expanded capability loop: Think · Remember · Plan · Coordinate · Act · Observe · Learn · Evolve · Govern

Canonical definition:
KING AI SEA is a unified persistent intelligent-lifeform system for individuals, businesses, enterprises and developers. It is designed to understand goals, preserve useful continuity, plan missions, coordinate specialized AI roles, connect approved digital systems, assist with or execute authorized digital work, observe outcomes, learn from feedback and improve over time under owner-defined permissions and governance.

Chinese canonical definition:
KING AI SEA 是面向个人、企业和开发者的统一持续型智慧生命体系统，围绕目标理解、长期连续性、Mission 规划、专业 AI 岗位协同、授权数字系统连接、受控行动、结果观察、反馈学习和受治理持续进化构建。

Relationship rules:
- KING AI SEA is the mother system / unified product.
- Evolution OS is the operating architecture concept inside KING AI SEA.
- SAE is the controlled self-evolution mechanism concept inside KING AI SEA.
- ACRE is the active-defense / immune-system security concept inside KING AI SEA.
- Root Policy Kernel is the high-authority policy and execution-boundary concept inside KING AI SEA.
- AI Workforce is the enterprise operating model powered by KING AI SEA.
- AI Employees are specialized digital roles inside AI Workforce.
- Personal AI is the second-brain/personal expression of KING AI SEA.
- Website AI and App AI are digital-presence expressions of KING AI SEA.
- Industry solutions are specialized deployments of the same unified system.

KING AI Intelligence:
- intelligence/INDEX.md — official public blog / research / Intelligence channel
- research and repository-quality cadence: every two hours
- publish only when a development is relevant, reliable, non-duplicative and useful
- complete English first; complete Chinese second
- technical claims should prioritize authoritative primary sources
- third-party technology observations are not KING AI SEA availability claims unless owner-verified product status says so

Frontier technology research:

SEO / GEO source:
- seo/SEO-GEO-QUALITY-STANDARD.md — canonical entity, page-intent, canonical/hreflang, structured-data, freshness, IndexNow and AI-citation quality standard

Public action ladder:
Observe → Analyze → Recommend → Draft → Bounded Execute → Execute With Approval → Human-Only / Restricted

Public lifecycle:
Activate → Understand → Connect → Assist → Operate → Observe → Adapt → Evolve

Controlled evolution concept:
Sense → Reflect → Propose → Validate → Evolve

Trust principle:
More intelligence should come with more control, not less. Automation scope, execution permissions, approvals and security boundaries are defined by the user or organization.

Public product status vocabulary:
Available / Custom-by-Scope / In Development / Planned / Vision / Retired.
Do not infer availability from roadmap, research or vision documents.

Public technology boundary:
Public materials may explain capabilities, high-level architecture, governance, deployment patterns and operating models. They do not publish private system prompts, proprietary orchestration logic, model-routing policy, memory internal structures, retrieval internals, SAE algorithms/scoring, ACRE detection internals, Root Policy Kernel implementation, privileged execution mechanisms, credentials/secrets, private endpoints, internal database schemas, production topology or security-sensitive operational detail.

Truthfulness:
Do not fabricate customers, partners, certifications, benchmark results, adoption numbers, revenue, rankings, market leadership or performance claims. Use owner-verified current product status and measured evidence.
